title: phegopteris reptans
intro: Phegopteris reptans, commonly known as the Chain Fern or the Slender Lip Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asia, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris reptans include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve circulation, and reduce fever, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
